titulo: Why You'd Never Want To Meet A Kraken

itens.nome: How Big the Kraken Really Was

titulo.descricao: The kraken rising beside a small 18th-century sailing ship at night, seen from far away; the creature is a colossal squid-like monster with long arms around the hull
buscas: The kraken, a colossal squid-like sea monster with a long mantle, huge round eyes and ten arms covered in hooked suckers, rising beside a small 18th-century three-masted sailing ship at night, seen from far away

estados.fala: In 1752 a Danish bishop wrote that the kraken was the size of a floating island.

cards.descricao: Old engraving of the kraken or a giant sea monster mistaken for an island, 16th–18th century

estados.fala: Its back, he said, was a mile and a half around.
textos: Its back is a mile and a half around

estados.fala: Sailors who had seen one gave numbers that were smaller, but still terrifying: forty meters from the tip of its arms to its tail.

cards.descricao: The kraken, full body, side view, arms stretched out, isolated on pure black, nothing else in the frame
buscas: The kraken, a colossal squid-like sea monster with a long mantle, huge round eyes and ten arms covered in hooked suckers, full body seen from the side with the arms stretched out behind it, isolated, nothing else in the frame

estados.fala: Now picture yourself on the deck, and the sea starts to boil.

cards.descricao: Point of view from the deck of an old wooden ship at night: the sea in front is bubbling and two enormous arms with hooked suckers rise out of the water
buscas: Point of view from the deck of an old wooden sailing ship at night: the sea ahead is boiling with bubbles and two enormous arms of the kraken, covered in hooked suckers, rise out of the water higher than the mast

estados.fala: The legend has a real animal behind it: the giant squid, which really grows to twelve meters.

cards.descricao: Old engraving of the kraken attacking a ship

estados.fala: And it is still out there, two kilometers down.
